versions.name: Stamp Collecting
versions.description: Tell a perforated stamp from an imperforate one and a definitive from a commemorative, handle them with tongs, gauges and mounts, and build an album around a country, a region, or a topic you care about.

provenance.notes: Introduction year (and BSA number where absent) backfilled from the USSSP merit badge history table; for a renamed badge this is when THIS name took effect, not when the lineage began.
